page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated physical cores using the AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. With a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, each of the 128 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage options for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and external services.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high vCPU density make this instance suitable for compute-intensive workloads that require predictable, sustained CPU performance without hyperthreading overhead. The lack of local storage and GPU hardware positions it specifically for CPU-bound tasks. Appropriate workloads include high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, and large-scale compute-heavy applications.
